summary.name: Susan Fowler blog
summary.one_liner: Personal blog of writer and engineer Susan Fowler, with posts on microservices, software engineering culture, and workplace ethics, now redirected to a Substack.
use_cases: find writing on tech industry ethics and workplace culture
follow the author's newer writing on Substack
summary.what_it_does: The page is a blog index listing several posts by Susan Fowler. Posts cover microservice standardization, a description of the four layers of microservice architecture (hardware, communication, application platform, and microservice layers), and a set of demands for tech companies on harassment, forced arbitration, and confidentiality agreements. Other posts are personal essays on grief and on her career moves between companies. The top note says she now blogs at squarknotes.substack.com and keeps some older posts online for posterity.
notable: Lists a post on the four layers of microservice architecture
Covers microservice standardization, including an interview with InfoQ and O'Reilly
Moved to a Substack newsletter, squarknotes.substack.com
caveats: Blog has moved to squarknotes.substack.com; only a few older posts remain here
Page is an index with excerpts; full post text is not included
